look_here_first: Look at the deep acorn cup that almost encloses the nut; then examine rounded leaf lobes and pale hairy undersides.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Swamp chestnut oak has a shallow acorn cup and toothed leaves; bur oak has a fringed cup rim.

images.role: Overcup oak leafy branch and GREEN developing acorn almost enveloped by deep knobby cup
images.creator: KATHERINE WAGNER-REISS

images.diagnostic_visibility: Actual image inspected from Morris Arboretum: green deeply lobed foliage with attached young large knobbly acorn cap; one developing acorn nearly enclosed by cup; not ripe brown mature fruit.
images.limitations: Cultivated plant in arboretum; not Hays/native-range evidence. Developing acorn, not proof of full ripe cup enclosure.
